findings.message: RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE changes the visual order of surrounding text without changing the underlying code -- the mechanism behind Trojan Source (CVE-2021-42574).
findings.suggestion: Remove this character unless the file is deliberately handling bidirectional text, in which case keep embeddings short, always balanced, and never spanning a comment/string boundary.

findings.message: RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE is opened but never closed before the end of the line.
findings.suggestion: Add the matching POP DIRECTIONAL FORMATTING (U+202C) or POP DIRECTIONAL ISOLATE (U+2069), or remove this character.
